verdict.rationale: Kimi is itself an AI assistant that analyzes user-provided material. Its million-token context loads a whole codebase for project-wide understanding (kimi-docs-6), and thinking-effort modes target large codebase analysis and long-document processing (kimi-docs-8). Agents read the user's local project files and act on them through conversation (kimi-docs-1, kimi-docs-2), and memory and deep-research features are listed in the help center (kimi-docs-14, kimi-docs-18). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of insights from structured or personal data such as spreadsheets and uploaded datasets, in-depth first-party docs (help-center entries are titles only), and independent hands-on corroboration of data-insight quality.
